8/30/2026
Dog would quickly retreat to back half of kennel with a tightly tucked tail on approach, slowly closed kennel divider.  Approached back half of kennel, dog would be in corner of kennel near divider wall, trembling body while whale eyes & ears pinned back.  Would not come forward for treats or verbal coaxing.  Slowly leashed dog, dog would slowly approach behavior taxi with verbal coaxing.  Rode to small PY while lying down curled in behavior taxi, trembling body.  Exited out & into small PY.  Would quickly retreat to corner of PY, laid down while trembling body.  Would not approach handler, was not interested in treats.  Would have intense skin crawling when handler would slowly pet dog on head & side of body while keeping head lowered, avoiding eye contact & making a crying sound.  Would not move from corner.  After a few more minutes, handler would reposition behavior taxi use a lot of verbal coaxing with slight leash pressure to coax dog to walk back into behavior taxi.  Would defecate while riding back to kennel, curled on bottom while trembling body.  Entered back into kennel quickly & removed leash with use of pre-attached clip leash while dog would be curled in back corner of kennel, trembling body, keeping head lowered & looking towards corner walls.
8/29/2026
Dog was lying outside against divider wall, side eyed handler, wouldn't come forward with treats or verbal coaxing, closed divider, met dog outside. Dog remained frozen in corner, averted gaze, ignored high value treats, wouldn't approach with verbal coaxing, shifted weight back and lowered head as handler reached in to place leash. Unable to coax out of kennel, handler positioned taxi directly in front of dog, slowly entered taxi without assistance, attempted to jump out on the way to yard, used leash pressure to hold dog in taxi. Once in yard dog slowly emerged from taxi, posture low, tail tucked, lied down in corner of yard, panting, lip licking, stared at handler, wouldn't approach with verbal coaxing, still not interested in high value treats. After a moment handler approached and sat on bench next to dog, dog shifted weight back, whale eyed, lip licking, salivating, head shy but allowed light petting, remained frozen in corner. Handler brought over taxi, able to guide into taxi with moderate leash pressure, no issues riding back to kennel, dog scurried to back of kennel and pancaked, used clip leash.
8/28/2026
Requesting full evaluation based on intake and previous observation note.

08/14/26  Surgery - scrotal and L spermatic cord ablation (d/t L scirrhous cord).
The patient was placed in DR.  An elliptical incision was made at the base of the scrotum.  The subcutaneous tissue was bluntly and sharply dissected with a Mayo scissor.  The scrotal sac was found to have a small draining tract along its ventral aspect and to be moderately edematous with firm tissue in the L side of the sac which extended deep into the L inguinal ring.  The subcutaneous tissue adhered to the firm L spermatic cord was bluntly dissected in order to fully expose the affected region of L spermatic cord.  A Carmalt was placed proximal to the affected region of the L spermatic cord and the L spermatic cord was then double ligated with strangle ligatures using 0 webmax.  The affected L spermatic cord and scrotum were then removed.  The surgeon then changed surgery gloves and obtained a new surgery pack.  The ablated scrotal region was lavaged with 1L LRS and cefazolin powder was placed in the L inguinal ring.  Each ring was then closed with simple continuous sutures using 0 webmax.  The deep subcutaneous layer was closed with simple continuous sutures using 0 webmax.  The continuous intradermal layer was closed using 2-0 webmax.  The skin was apposed with skin staples and Aluspray was applied along the incision.
A:  L scirrhous cord
P:  1.  Maintain dog in an e-collar for the next 12-14 days.
2.  Amoxi/clav (375mg tablet) - 1 tablet PO BID x 14 days.
3.  Metronidazole (250mg tablet) - 1.5 tablets PO BID x 7 days.
4.  Carprofen (100mg tablet) - 1 tablet PO SID x 7 days.
5.  Schedule skin staple removal in 12 days.
6.  Dog is not suitable to PUFA/ foster at this time.  Overall recheck on 8/18/26.
